title: Book Three · Chapter 116: A Useful Question
story:
By early winter, the classroom windows stay shut during lessons.

On Thursday, Kai puts a small cardboard box on the front desk. There are two room plans beside it.

The class has a practical maths task. Each group must choose a plan and explain the choice.

Ronan's group has measured the cardboard walls. Kai made the little box. Another boy wrote the numbers on the board.

Before their turn, Ronan tries his explanation quietly for the group. He holds the box in front of his chest. Kai can see the bottom, but not the door.

“Are you teaching your shirt?” Kai asks.

Ronan lowers the model. Then he tries to hold the plan too. The loose wall falls against his hand.

“I will hold that,” the other boy says.

They try again. The boy holds each plan beside the box. Kai stands farther back and watches.

“This time, we can see it.”

They set the box down. Soon it is their turn.

Now Ronan must explain the door.

He picks up the box. There are two possible places for the opening.

“Here, the door can open all the way,” he says.

He shows the first plan, then the second.

“Here, it hits this table.”

He moves a flat piece of card against the little table. It stops halfway.

A boy at the back raises a hand.

“Use a smaller table.”

Ronan looks at Kai. The table must hold four people. That is on the task sheet.

“Then two people eat outside,” Ronan says.

The class laughs. He puts the sheet beside the model and explains the four places.

The teacher asks about the clear floor space. Ronan knows the room size. He does not know the answer after the furniture goes in.

He starts with the whole floor, then stops.

“I need the table size too.”

Kai finds the measurement. Together they put the right numbers on the board. Ronan finishes the explanation with the model in his hands.

At lunch, Kai pushes his box toward him.

“You can keep the dangerous door.”

“It only attacks tables.”

Anna comes over with her own plan. Her group chose a different opening.

“The teacher asked about your floor space too?” Ronan asks.

“Yes. We missed one chair.”

She points to an empty place on the drawing.

Ronan smiles. “Someone eats outside again.”

“We put the chair back.”

Anna sits down and moves her lunch away from the model.

“Your explanation was clear,” she says.

“The sum needed help.”

“Mine did too.”

She shows him a crossed-out number. Then she takes the drawing to the teacher with a question about the wider door.

Ronan eats while Kai folds the loose wall flat. The little table falls out onto his sleeve.

“Another customer outside,” Ronan says.

Kai picks it up and puts it through the opening.

After lunch, the teacher places the models on a side shelf. Ronan helps carry them. He keeps one hand beneath Kai's box and leaves the door open so the next person can pass.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

cardboard＝硬纸板；floor space＝地面空间；measurement＝量得的尺寸；crossed-out＝划掉的。

## 理解问题

1. Ronan怎样让全班明白门和桌子的冲突？为什么不能简单换小桌？
2. 他答不出面积问题时实际做了什么？Anna自己的计算是否一次就全对？

## 读句子

**Together they put the right numbers on the board.**

拆开看：Together / they put / the right numbers / on the board.

两人一起／写下／正确的数字／在黑板上。
